title: Share of an Earlier Suspension Counted against a New Personal Services Plan Suspension
content:
When a Personal Services Plan package is suspended for as long as the package allows, the plan's most recent recorded suspension is counted against the new one at a share that depends on why and how long ago it was taken. The rule reads the hospital or rehabilitation absence recorded on the resident's assisted living residency under the Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement.

## Rule

The months counted for the most recent recorded suspension are taken at one of three shares: where that suspension lay within a hospital or rehabilitation absence recorded on the resident's assisted living residency, at none; where it did not and it ended at least 3 whole months before the request, at 0.5, rounded down to a whole month; otherwise in full.

- **Lay within a hospital or rehabilitation absence:** the absence reason recorded on the assisted living residency is a hospital stay or a rehabilitation facility stay, the absence start date is on or before the first day of that suspension, and the absence return date is either not recorded or on or after the last day of that suspension.
- **Ended at least 3 whole months before the request:** whole months are counted from the suspension's end date to the date of the request, a whole month elapsing on the same day of each later month.
- **Months counted:** the share is applied to the months counted for that suspension — those that ended fewer than 12 whole months before the request — and the result is rounded down to a whole month.

## Ladder

| Most recent recorded suspension | Share of its counted months |
|---|---|
| Lay within a recorded hospital or rehabilitation absence | None |
| Otherwise, ended 3 or more whole months before the request | 0.5, rounded down to a whole month |
| Otherwise | In full |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical suspension ended 30 June, not within an absence)

| Request dated | Whole months since 30 June | Share |
|---|---|---|
| 29 September | 2 | In full |
| 30 September | 3 | 0.5 |

## Worked examples (hypothetical)

- 2 months counted, suspension ended 5 whole months before the request, not within an absence: 2 multiplied by 0.5 is 1 month.
- 3 months counted at the 0.5 share: 1.5, rounded down to 1 month.
- 1 month counted at the 0.5 share: 0.5, rounded down to 0 months.
- A suspension of January and February taken while the assisted living residency recorded a rehabilitation absence starting 20 December and returning 10 March: it lay within the absence, so none of its months are counted.
